description: Single source of truth for the plugin version. Every consumer below must agree. Validated by scripts/check-version-truth.sh; repaired by `scripts/check-version-truth.sh --sync`. Never edit a consumer by hand — edit this file, then sync.

consumers.note: Claude Code / Claude Desktop plugin manifest. Claude treats this value as the marketplace update cache key.
The guard plugin's manifest (plugins/guard, installed from the in-repo marketplace). Versioned in lockstep with the core plugin so one release moves both.
Codex CLI plugin manifest (pre-0.147 fallback overlay). Generated by scripts/build-manifests.sh.

Root Agent Plugins 1.0 manifest (Codex >= 0.147, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Kiro). Generated by scripts/build-manifests.sh from this file, so it can only disagree when the generator was not re-run after a bump; --sync repairs the copy, `bash scripts/build-manifests.sh .` is the canonical fix.
Gemini CLI extension manifest. Created by the Gemini adapter work; absent trees skip this consumer rather than failing.
README version badge — the first version a visitor sees.
Records which plugin version last reviewed the platform targets.

Latest released heading below [Unreleased]. Advisory only: a manifest bump legitimately lands before its release section is written, so a mismatch warns instead of failing, and --sync never rewrites changelog history.
